_about: The page set and hub content for this vendor: every dataset the site documents, grouped as the hub lists it, with its families. Rendered by gridflow-build.
name: Elexon BMRS
intro: Great Britain’s balancing mechanism, from Elexon’s Insights API: system prices, generation outturn, BM-unit data, and demand and wind forecasts.
facts: Half-hourly settlement periods, 1 to 50 a day (46 or 50 when the clocks change); FUELINST every 5 minutes

landing.desc: GB balancing mechanism: prices, generation, demand, BM units and forecasts
start: outturn by fuel type, no solar
market index, the GB day-ahead benchmark

groups_note: The groups are this site’s way in. In gridflow’s code they differ by how each is requested: most take a from/to publish-time window; `system_prices` and `market_depth` take a settlement date in the path, `pn` a settlement date and period, and `bmunits_reference` nothing at all.

groups.name: Prices and balancing
groups.blurb: What the system paid to balance, and the actions behind it.

groups.name: Generation and availability
groups.blurb: What ran, by fuel and by unit, and what is declared available.

groups.name: Demand
groups.blurb: Outturn and forecasts, national and transmission, from the day ahead to 14 days out.

groups.name: System indicators
groups.blurb: Indicated generation, demand, imbalance and margin; loss-of-load probability, frequency and temperature.

groups.name: Reference and messages
groups.blurb: The register of BM units, and outage and unavailability notices.

names.agws: Actual or estimated wind and solar generation
names.fou2t14d: Generation availability by fuel, 2 to 14 days ahead
names.uou2t14d: Generation availability by BM unit, 2 to 14 days ahead
names.atl: Actual total load per bidding zone
names.lolpdrm: Loss of load probability and de-rated margin
